_comment: Round-robin reviewer rotation used by review_rotation.yml. Adding `label` to a PR requests a review from the next available pool member; the PR author can comment /reroll to pick someone else. A member with only the "ux" role (no "engineering") is skipped unless the PR touches one of visual_path_prefixes -- see eligible_pool() in review_rotation.py. A pool member counts as off for the day when a team-calendar event today has one of their calendar_names AND an off word (see OFF_WORDS in scripts/review_rotation/review_rotation.py) in its title, and it's either all-day or their off events that day add up to at least min_off_hours (so a short appointment doesn't count). Slack IDs come from slack_user_map.json.
label: ready-for-human-review
